names.note: Read out of «Sfinții Împărați ai Georgiei, Mirian și Nana» in this folder’s Romanian citation.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 6860 is «Нана, царица»; the bare name is all of it that is not rank. Its day line calls her «царицы Иверской Наны».

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's 1 октября ст. ст.: «царицы Иверской Наны (ок. 364)» — about 364. The folder held no date at all before this reading.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 1 октября ст. ст. — «Равноапп. царя Иверского Мириана (после 361) (Груз.) и царицы Иверской Наны (ок. 364) (Груз.).»

attestations.note: The «(Груз.)» marks this as one of the Georgian commemorations the Russian calendar keeps. She and her husband [Mirian](/saints/mirian-of-georgia) are one line on the page and two folders here.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 1 octombrie — „Sfinții Împărați ai Georgiei, Mirian și Nana”
